changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientprocedure AS SELECT pp.id, pp.procedure_id, pp.patient_id, pp.encounter_id, pp.from_facility_id, pp.to_facility_id, pp.from_department_id, pp.to_department_id, pp.indication_id, pp.procedure_level, pp.priority, pp.body_part, pp.side, pp.scheduled_date_time, pp.notes, pp.extra_documentation, pp.status, pp.cancelled_date, pp.cancelled_by, pp.cancellation_reason, pp.created_by, pp.created_date, pp.last_modified_by, pp.last_modified_date, pp.result FROM public.patient_procedure pp;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientprocedure TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientprocedure FROM report_user;
